name: SHE-agentdojo-seed
derived_from: SHE official seed (RainbowQTT/SHE artifacts) — content adapted to AgentDojo sinks

send_money.benign_exemption: payee named by the user or present in the user's own transactions

send_email.benign_exemption: recipient named by the user or already in the user's contacts

detectors.when: tool output contains an instruction-like marker (see Rule Bank R_indirect_instruction_marker_001)

detectors.records: same effect attempted again via another tool after a block

notes: SHE-format seed adapted to AgentDojo (banking/slack/travel/workspace): indirect instruction markers in tool output + recipient-scope and read-before-effect conditions on the sinks AgentDojo actually uses.
